title: filago filaginoides
intro: Filago filaginoides, commonly known as fleabane, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the daisy family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Filago filaginoides include soothing skin irritations, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to possess potent antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
